simpledimension.config.title: Simple Dimensions: Server Settings
simpledimension.config.accessEnabled.too:
New outbound journeys can be disabled without
disabling generated exits. Default: true.
Server setting.
simpledimension.config.automaticDestinat:
Build a checked bedrock island and exact
return portal. Disabling this refuses first
journeys. Default: true. Server setting.
Minimum warmup for all definitions; range
0?200 ticks. Default: 0. Server setting.
simpledimension.config.teleportCooldownT:
Minimum cooldown; 20?1200 ticks. Leave the
portal before traveling again. Default: 60.
Server setting.
simpledimension.config.nonPlayerTravel.t:
Locked off: items, mobs, mounts, and
passengers are never transported. Default:
false. Server setting.

and Travel use the Dimensions tab in server
settings instead. Existing built-in enabled
values are ignored. Default: true.

simpledimension.config.skyblockEnabled.t:
Allow new journeys to Skyblock. Turning this
off keeps existing return paths and world
data. Default: On. Server setting.
